snippet.title: Evercade - Indie Heroes Collection 4 - Trailer
snippet.description:
The Indie Heroes return to Evercade with another lineup of new games made for (and in the style of) vintage gaming hardware. Includes the dig-and-bomb 'em up action of Murtop, the inimitable bouncy platforming of Flea!2, Batty Zabella's saucy adventures and many more!

Coming February 2025
Pre-orders open January 30th, 2025

Find out more: https://evercade.co.uk/cartridges/indie-heroes-collection-4/
